skills.requirements: Provided by the game server at runtime; not stored in the PCK

skills.name: Transmutation
skills.description: Rewrite a weapon's element. Slot a weapon, pick a new element, and pay the alchemy matter matching the weapon's tier, the essence matching your chosen element and tier, and Soul Crystals. Every echo already on the weapon raises the whole cost by 30%. Dark items cannot be transmuted.
skills.requirements: Provided by the game server at runtime; not stored in the PCK
